Measure glossary

OTD%

DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Fact_Purchases),Fact_Purchases[OnTimeFlag]=1),COUNTROWS(Fact_Purchases))

Reads from Fact_Purchases · Used on Executive Control Tower, Operations & Supplier Risk, Supplier Scorecard

PO Spend

SUM(Fact_Purchases[POAmount])

Reads from Fact_Purchases · Used on Operations & Supplier Risk, Supplier Scorecard

OTIF%

DIVIDE([OTIF],COUNTROWS(Fact_Shipments))

Reads from Fact_Shipments · Used on Executive Control Tower, Warehouse Snapshot

Supplier Defect Rate %

DIVIDE(
    SUM(Fact_Purchases[DefectQty]),SUM(Fact_Purchases[ReceivedQty]))

Reads from Fact_Purchases · Used on Operations & Supplier Risk, Supplier Scorecard

Avg Lead Time (Actual)

AVERAGEX(Fact_Purchases,Fact_Purchases[ReceivedDate]-Fact_Purchases[OrderDate])

Reads from Fact_Purchases · Used on Operations & Supplier Risk, Supplier Scorecard

Avg Lead Time Variance

AVERAGEX(Fact_Purchases,Fact_Purchases[ActualLeadTimeDays]-Fact_Purchases[PlannedLeadTimeDays])

Reads from Fact_Purchases · Used on Operations & Supplier Risk, Supplier Scorecard

PPV %

DIVIDE([PPV (Purchase Price Variance)],SUMX(Fact_Purchases,Fact_Purchases[StandardUnitCost]*Fact_Purchases[ReceivedQty]))

Revenue

SUMX(Dim_Product,SUMX(RELATEDTABLE(Fact_Sales),Fact_Sales[SalesAmount]))

Reads from Fact_Sales, Dim_Product · Used on Executive Control Tower

Stockout Rate %

DIVIDE([Stock-out SKU-Months],[Active SKU-Months])

Reads from Fact_Inventory · Used on Executive Control Tower

Supplier OTD Status

VAR _v = [OTD%] * 100
VAR _g = LOOKUPVALUE ( Ref_Risk_Thresholds[GreenThreshold], Ref_Risk_Thresholds[Metric], "On-Time Delivery (Inbound)" )
VAR _a = LOOKUPVALUE ( Ref_Risk_Thresholds[AmberThreshold], Ref_Risk_Thresholds[Metric], "On-Time Delivery (Inbound)" )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( [OTD%] ), BLANK (), SWITCH ( TRUE (), _v >= _g, "On Track", _v >= _a, "Watch", "At Risk" ) )

Reads from Ref_Risk_Thresholds, Fact_Purchases · Used on Executive Control Tower, Operations & Supplier Risk, Supplier Scorecard

VAR sel = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'CY_Dynamic Line'[CY_Dynamic Line Order], 0 )

        sel,
        0, [Revenue],
        1, [OTIF%],
        2, [In_full %],
        3, [On_Time %]
    )

Reads from PL Lines, Dim_Date, Fact_Sales, Dim_Warehouse, Dim_Product, Dim_Customer, Fact_Shipments, Fact_Purchases · Used on

PL Amount

VAR lineId = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'PL Lines'[LineID] )
VAR gross = [Gross Sales (List Price)]
VAR disc = [Total Discount Value]
VAR netrev = [Revenue]
VAR cogs = [Total COGS]
VAR gp = [Gross_Profit]
VAR frt = [Freight Cost]
VAR ppv = [PPV (Purchase Price Variance)]
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        lineId,
        1, gross,
        2, -disc,
        3, netrev,
        4, -cogs,
        5, gp,
        6, -frt,
        7, -ppv,
        8, gp - frt - ppv
    )
